# Course Calendar

```{r setup, include = F}
library(googlesheets4)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)

gs4_deauth()

google_sheet <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A8JUQ0_Po_nt4UKkrtOnRYzqRLaG7ii6IZ4yarcxi9k/edit?usp=sharing")
```

```{r}
#| echo: False
#| column: page

google_sheet %>%
  select(-Admin_Notes, -Day) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_date(Date, date_style = 31) %>%
  sub_missing(columns = c(Week, Reading, Topic, `Homework`, `Lecture`, `Lab`), missing_text = "") %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "right",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      style = "solid"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = c(Date, Topic, Reading)
    )
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center", 
    columns = c(Week)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "right", 
    columns = c(Date)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left", 
    columns = c(`Lecture`,
                `Lab`
                )
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(Week, Reading, Topic, `Lecture`, `Lab`, `Homework`)
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Week ~ pct(4),
    Date ~ pct(13), 
    Reading ~ pct(14),
    Topic ~ pct(15),
    `Lecture` ~ pct(18),
    `Lab` ~ pct(20),
    `Homework` ~ pct(17)
  ) %>%
  cols_label_with(fn = function(x) {
      janitor::make_clean_names(x, case = "title") %>%
        toupper() %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("^|$", "**") %>%
        md()
    }) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 15) %>%
  opt_row_striping()
```
